findings.summary: Luna missed two current official drink-menu surfaces and the corresponding current drink catalog boundary.
Fifteen frozen items are Mount Pleasant-only and should not be reconciled as Shaw products.
Restaurant-issued dietary markers and descriptions support only named positive ingredients/contains markers. They do not establish complete arrays, negatives, or item-specific may-contain claims.
The catering notice is restaurant-issued global kitchen cross-contact context for nuts/seeds, flour, and shellfish; it cannot populate individual may-contain arrays.
Frozen headers and Add shrimp modifier text were extracted as standalone items.

summary: Independent verification found material catalog-scope discrepancies. Luna covered four accessible scout surfaces but missed both official drink-menu surfaces and Toast alcoholic drinks; its consolidated food product also obscures separate Shaw/Mount Pleasant scope. All 61 frozen keys were reconciled exactly once. Restaurant-issued sources support narrow peanuts, sesame, and shellfish positives only; global cross-contact language is not item-level may-contain evidence.
